data.headline: The Library of Alexandria
data.subheadline: What really happened to the ancient world's knowledge

data.myth: Julius Caesar burned down the Library in a single catastrophic fire
data.fact: The Library declined gradually over centuries through multiple incidents
data.proof: Historical records show fires in 48 BCE, 270s CE, and final destruction around 640 CE

data.context: scrolls estimated to have been housed at the Library's peak
data.takeaway: Represented the accumulated knowledge of the ancient Mediterranean world
